articles.summary: A big update to Hana's design tools. The 3D transform tools introduced last year get a big overhaul: you can now turn objects in 3D directly on the canvas, with a rotation handle, a selection box that follows the object, and a new 3D Transform panel. Auto layout gets a Grid mode, layers can have multiple fills, and files have a version history. There is also a command palette, line and arrow tools, variable-width strokes, text on a path, outline mode, find and replace, and multi-page PDF export. Read the blog post for a full walkthrough.
articles.title: Hana: 3D transform tools, Grid layout and Version history
